newsitem.title: JAPAN: Saudi cuts June Arab Super Light formula to Asia.
newsitem.headline: Saudi cuts June Arab Super Light formula to Asia.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has said it will cut its June-lifting crude oil price formula for Arab Super Light to Asian customers by 60 cents per barrel, traders in Tokyo said on Tuesday.
The June term contract price for Arab Super Light was set at the Oman/Dubai average plus $2.10, compared with plus $2.70 for May, traders said.
The June crude price formula for other Saudi crude grades remains unchanged from the previous month, traders said earlier.

The June price formula for Arab Light was set at the Oman/Dubai average plus 50 cents, Arab Medium was Oman/Dubai minus 50 cents, Arab Heavy was Oman/Dubai minus $1.35 and for Berri Extra Light it was Oman/Dubai plus $1.50.
